summary: LLM7 provides anonymous text generation with limits of 1 request per second, 10 per minute, 60 per hour, and 500,000 tokens per 24 hours. A free token raises the request and token limits.
claim_steps: Send an OpenAI-compatible request without a key using a currently available turbo model.
Stay within the anonymous limits of 10 requests per minute, 60 per hour, and 500,000 tokens per 24 hours.
Optionally get a free token from the LLM7 dashboard for higher limits.

social_proof.title: Limits | LLM7.io Documentation
social_proof.text: Anonymous access allows 1 request per second, 10 per minute, 60 per hour, and 500,000 tokens per 24 hours.
